name: hold small sends until the previous one is acknowledged
mechanism: buffer small outgoing pieces while an earlier piece is unacknowledged and send them together, so many tiny messages become fewer larger ones

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Nagle's algorithm' in section Networking: improve the efficiency of TCP/IP networks by coalescing packets

fails_when: interacts badly with delayed acknowledgements (latency stalls)
